labels.label: lem:positivity
labels.notes: Paper block Yamabegap.tex l.715-721 read in full; the sentence formalised is l.720, « The trace operator W^{1,2}(Σ) → L²(∂Σ) is compact ». (1) Statement unchanged: `git diff 9fbefdd -- lean-yamabe/scaffold/YamabeScaffold/TraceCompact.lean` touches only the import line (+ `import YamabeScaffold.TraceInterp`), the module docstring and the proof body after `:= by`. The theorem's docstring, binders, hypotheses and conclusion are byte-for-byte those of 9fbefdd (#check printed: CompactSpace, T2Space, IsManifold (𝓡∂ N) ∞, g, IsLocallyLebesgue N μ, IsBoundaryMeasure N σ, ∀ k IsC1 N (u k), ∃ K : ℝ≥0, ∀ k, w12 g μ (u k) ≤ K ⊢ ∃ φ StrictMono, ∃ f, MemLp f 2 σ ∧ eLpNorm (u (φ k) - f) 2 σ → 0). Readings: W^{1,2} through C¹ (OQ-93 (b), OPEN), volume any IsLocallyLebesgue μ and area any IsBoundaryMeasure σ (OQ-93 (a); both satisfiable, the Riemannian volume and area are instances, σ = 0 is allowed but not forced, so the statement is not vacuous). The C¹ reading is narrower than the paper's W^{1,2} operator; it is disclosed in the docstring checklist (⚠ read), in SCOPE and in REPORT.questions, and the row is `partial`, unmarked. The limit f is not identified with the trace of the L²(μ) limit; disclosed in SCOPE (identification goes through Mfd.const_of_tendsto and Mfd.trace_embedding, both exist in the strict library, namespace Yamabe.Mfd). SCOPE's claim that lem_positivity uses only TraceIneq and not the compactness is true (Yamabe/Rellich.lean l.68, l.92, l.142). Nothing in Yamabe/ or the scaffold consumes trace_compact. (2) The interpolation is genuine. Half.trace_interp_halfSpace: trace_halfSpace at q = 2 (∫|w(0,z)|² ≤ 2∫_{t>0}|w||∂_t w|, strict Trace.lean:159) applied to w = Half.ext v ∘ Φ, |∂_t w| bounded by ‖extD v (Φ p)‖ (opNorm, ‖Φ(1,0)‖ = 1), 2ab ≤ δ²b² + δ⁻²a², pass to ℍ̄ by lintegral_mono_set and the measure-preserving Φ, then δ²D² + δ⁻²V² ≤ (δD + δ⁻¹V)²; no constant is lost. Mfd.local_trace_interp: every constant (c of eLpNorm_dChart_mul_le, c2 = Cμ^{1/2}, cσ = Cσ^{1/2}, cK of eLpNorm_hyperplane_le) is fixed before `∀ δ u w`, and the statement's quantifier order is ∃ C, ∀ δ > 0, ∀ u w, which is what makes the inequality an interpolation; the derivative term is split in the chart (fderivWithin_sub, eLpNorm_sub_le on continuous fderivWithin), the measurability argument of kb_proposals[0] is correct. Mfd.trace_interp_sub assembles by Mfd.assemble_family over the subtype J of (δ, u, w), C independent of j; Mfd.trace_interp is the w = 0 case (w12 0 = 0 via gradNorm_const_zero). The right-hand sides are finite for C¹ inputs (w12 < ⊤, memLp_of_isC1), so the inequality is not satisfied by ⊤. In trace_compact, A comes from trace_interp_sub before ε; for ε, r ∈ (0, ε) real, δ = r/(4(AK+1)), η = rδ/(8(A+1)), then N₀ from the L²(μ) convergence of Rellich's subsequence. Check: A·δ·2K ≤ r/2 and A·δ⁻¹·2η = A r/(4(A+1)) ≤ r/4, so the bound is ≤ 3r/4 < r < ε. δ is chosen against K before the index, hA is applied to u (φ m), u (φ l): the proof genuinely uses the interpolation. Completeness of Lp ℝ 2 σ and Lp.tendsto_Lp_iff_tendsto_eLpNorm' give the limit; the subsequence returned is Rellich's φ (StrictMono). (3) No label is marked in either file (`lem:positivity` written without **, the ledger's docstring_label_re needs a `prefix:` so the bold `**`Mfd.trace_compact`**`, `**`Mfd.trace_interp_sub`**`, `**`Mfd.trace_interp`**` are not parsed as marks).
